# Drift & champion/challenger scenario (generated by `scripts/drift_scenario.py`)

Champion = gradient-boosting RUL model trained on FD001 fit engines (HPC degradation, one operating condition). New fleet = FD003 (HPC **and fan** degradation, same operating condition).

## Drift detection (PSI per sensor vs the healthy FD001 baseline = first 30 cycles of FD001 training engines; ≥0.25 = alert)

| Stream window | Sensors in alert | Top PSI |
|---|---|---|
| FD001 test, first 30 cycles (in-distribution) | 0 / 15 | s14 0.07, s9 0.06, s12 0.04, s4 0.03 |
| FD003 test, first 30 cycles (new fleet, healthy phase) | 9 / 15 | s13 0.46, s8 0.45, s11 0.44, s17 0.36 |
| FD001 test, last 30 observed cycles | 12 / 15 | s11 0.65, s4 0.64, s7 0.60, s12 0.60 |
| FD003 test, last 30 observed cycles | 10 / 15 | s15 0.75, s12 0.74, s7 0.68, s21 0.48 |

Sensors in alert in the degraded FD003 stream but **not** in the degraded FD001 stream (new failure signature the champion never saw): s14, s9.

## Champion vs challenger (challenger retrained on FD001 + FD003 fit engines)

| Model | FD001 calib RMSE | FD003 calib RMSE | FD001 test RMSE | FD003 test RMSE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Champion (FD001 only) | 15.38 | 17.30 | 16.64 | 20.73 |
| Challenger (FD001 + FD003) | 14.26 | 12.86 | 14.60 | 14.96 |

Decision rule (calibration engines only): promote if the challenger is better on FD003 and not worse than the champion by more than 0.5 RMSE on FD001. **Decision: promote challenger.** Test columns are reported after the decision, for transparency.
